name: Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company - Luberef
summary: Luberef, officially named Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company, engages in the manufacturing and worldwide sale of base oils and a diverse portfolio of by-products. Its extensive product line features both Group I and Group II base oils, complemented by various derivatives such as asphalt, marine heavy fuel oil, slack wax, extract, and sulfur. The company further supplies white products, including ultra-low sulfur diesel, naphtha, and drilling fluid. Founded in 1976, this enterprise maintains its headquarters in Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, operating as a subsidiary of the Saudi Arabian Oil Company.
